summary: The Semantic Definition Format (SDF) lets domain experts describe data and interaction models for Things, meaning physical objects reachable over a network. An SDF specification defines objects and their properties, actions and events in a common format.

eli5.summary: This is a standard way to write a manual for a smart gadget, saying what it can tell you and what it can do, so different systems understand it.

questions: what is sdf semantic definition format
